ar_c0p1__arditi_allpos.alpha_equiv_note: alpha_equiv is an ARITHMETIC conversion c * ||r_raw|| / ||h||_ref, where ||h||_ref was measured on PROMPT tokens under PREFILL-ONLY serving. This unit writes at decode positions too, where ||h|| differs, so the figure is for comparability with the prefill-only ladder and is NEVER a claim about the dose realised at decode. The measured realised dose is recorded beside it, per rung.
